payload.query:
query UserInfo {
  userInfo {
    ...userFields
  }
}

fragment userFields on User {
  id
  role
  login
  email
  firstName
  lastName
  phoneNumber
  avatar
  avatarSkin
  isActive
  isConfirmEmail
  isRegistrationComplete
  canReceiveConfirmationEmail
  coins
  createDate
  firstGradeDate
  freeAIQueries
  cards {
    createDate
    id
    pan
    mainCard
  }
  subscriptions {
    ...userSubscriptionFields
  }
  students {
    id
    firstName
    avatar
    attributes
    classRooms {
      id
      grade
      name
      studentName
      teacherName
      schoolName
      isClassrep
    }
    bitConfig
    firstGradeDate
    accessabilitySettings {
      themeName
      fontFamily
      fontSizeInPx
      letterSpacingIncreasingInPercent
      isClearScreen
    }
  }
  school {
    address
    name
    place
  }
  schoolPermissions {
    canEditSchool
  }
  attributes
  contractType
  externalUserSource
  limitUsage
  isGuest
  hasNewAuth
  educontSchoolName
  educontSchoolId
  educont {
    educontUid
    isActive
    role
    allowedCourses
    educationalInstitutions {
      approvedStatus
      isActual
      educationalInstitution {
        id
        shortName
        inn
        kpp
        address
        region
        typeEducationalInstitution
      }
    }
  }
  parentId
  parent {
    _id
    email
    isConfirmEmail
  }
  godMode
  permissions {
    id
    slug
    description
  }
  isFutureCode
  bitConfig
  disableBillings
  accessabilitySettings {
    themeName
    fontFamily
    fontSizeInPx
    letterSpacingIncreasingInPercent
    isClearScreen
  }
  codeOfFuturePermissions
  showAIHints
  coursesFavourites {
    courses
    modules
    units
    elements
  }
  isEducont
  hasSchoolsAccess
  educontSchool {
    schoolEmployeeId
    shortName
    schoolUuid
  }
  shouldShowEducontCodeErrorNotification
}

fragment userSubscriptionFields on UserSubscription {
  id
  allowRecurring
  cardId
  orderId
  classroomId
  status
  isActive
  activeDate
  endDate
  deleteDate
  plan {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  nextPlan {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  subscription {
    ...subscriptionFields
  }
}

fragment subscriptionFields on Subscription {
  id
  name
  role
  type
  description
  weight
  createDate
  updateDate
  deleteDate
  labels
  displayCardIcon
  displayCardSize
  plans {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  discounts {
    id
    type
  }
  configuration {
    subjectIds
    categoryIds
    chatRequests
    giftChatRequests
    tasksCount
    studentsQuantityInClassroom
    unlimitedAccessToTeachersTasks
    hintsForTeachersTasks
  }
  classObjectId
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionPlanFields on SubscriptionPlan {
  id
  numberOfStudents
  pricingPolicy
  period
  price
  timeline
  priceBefore
  pricePerMonth
  pricePerMonthBefore
  discount
  quotaOfTasks
  coins
  subjectPrices {
    id
    subjectId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
  categoryPrices {
    id
    categoryId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
}

query Meta {
  meta {
    categoryTags {
      id
      tag
      type
      textColor
      backgroundColor
      activeColor
      icon
      chips
    }
    classes {
      id
      isActive
      name
      weight
      code
      digit
      isSchoolProgram
    }
    subjects {
      id
      isActive
      lockedClasses
      name
      weight
      color
      code
      isSchoolProgram
      isEducontTeacher
    }
    customDiagnostics {
      id
      name
      classId
      subjectId
    }
    marketItems {
      ...gameItemFragment
    }
    links {
      id
      href
      icon
      label
    }
    sortVariants {
      id
      name
      type
      subjectId
      classId
      code
    }
    labels {
      _id
      name
      icon
      isGroup
      parentId
    }
    directorClassrooms {
      text
      value
    }
  }
}

fragment gameItemFragment on GameItem {
  id
  objectId
  type
  name
  price
  payload {
    value
    items {
      objectId
      chance
    }
    image
    inStore
    inGameStore
    color1
    color2
    background
    borderColor
  }
  description
  purchaseDate
  group
  weight
  isReward
  isLimited
}

query shopCatalog {
  shopCatalog {
    groups {
      ...subscriptionGroupFlatFields
    }
    subscriptions {
      ...subscriptionFields
      design
    }
  }
}

fragment subscriptionGroupFlatFields on SubscriptionGroupFlat {
  id
  name
  type
  shortDescription
  longDescription
  iconUrl
  backgroundColor
  role
  weight
  subscriptions
  subscriptionsImages {
    id
    imageUrl
  }
  parentId
  bannerType
  bannerPosition
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionFields on Subscription {
  id
  name
  role
  type
  description
  weight
  createDate
  updateDate
  deleteDate
  labels
  displayCardIcon
  displayCardSize
  plans {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  discounts {
    id
    type
  }
  configuration {
    subjectIds
    categoryIds
    chatRequests
    giftChatRequests
    tasksCount
    studentsQuantityInClassroom
    unlimitedAccessToTeachersTasks
    hintsForTeachersTasks
  }
  classObjectId
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionPlanFields on SubscriptionPlan {
  id
  numberOfStudents
  pricingPolicy
  period
  price
  timeline
  priceBefore
  pricePerMonth
  pricePerMonthBefore
  discount
  quotaOfTasks
  coins
  subjectPrices {
    id
    subjectId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
  categoryPrices {
    id
    categoryId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
}

query catalogCategories($showAll: Boolean, $categoryId: String) {
  catalogCategories(showAll: $showAll, categoryId: $categoryId) {
    ...catalogCategoryFields
  }
}

fragment catalogCategoryFields on Category {
  id
  parentId
  parentCode
  name
  shortDescription
  description
  fullDescription
  image
  lottie
  imageOffsetX
  imageOffsetY
  imageScale
  color
  weight
  code
  size
  type
  availabilityType
  tags
  classId
  subjectId
  coursesObjectIds
  externalMaterial
  hidden
  isActive
  practiceId
  durationMinutes
  validFromDate
  validToDate
  practiceId
  bannerComponent
  updatedAt
  educont
  educontOnly
  iconUrl
  educontCourses {
    externalId
    label
    link
  }
  randomizedContent {
    classId
    subjectId
    taskQuantity
  }
  showKeys
  teacherThemeGroupMode
  eor
  isPurchased
  tariffTitle
}
